name: Yabadabadoo
author: Utility Muffin Research Kitchen
description: Experimental. Adds Yabadabadoo, a Sega Saturn core tuned for low-power handhelds, as an alternate core for the Sega Saturn system. It runs in its own 32-bit RetroArch, bundled with everything it needs, which Leaf drives like its own: the in-game menu, Game Switcher and save state on power hold work as with other cores.
